instantiated_cells.justification: Section 13.69 prescribes forfeitures and criminal penalties for violations of lobbying disclosure requirements, including acting as a lobbyist without being licensed, violating ss. 13.61 to 13.68, and filing statements that are not believed to be true.

Section 13.74(1) requires the ethics commission to cause an examination of all required statements (a compliance review/audit function) but does not mandate routine audits by an external independent third party, supporting a moderate score rather than a yes.
